factionRules.name: Foreign Support
factionRules.text: White Soldiers never become Out of Ammo. A natural 1 on a Supply check only ends the action.

rules.name: Careful Planning
rules.text: After all Soldiers are deployed, you may redeploy one of yours.

rules.name: Professional Officers
rules.text: Your Commander may give up to 4 Orders per Round.

rules.name: Charismatic Leader
rules.text: Soldiers within 16 cm of the Commander get +1 to Conviction tests.

rules.name: Last Stand
rules.text: When one of your Soldiers is about to be removed, he may first make one free Shoot or Fight.

rules.name: Kornilovtsy
rules.text: You may take any number of Colour Regiment Soldiers, and they cost 2 points less.

factionRules.name: Class Consciousness
factionRules.text: A failed Order doesn't cost the Soldier an action.

factionRules.name: Tula Arsenals
factionRules.text: Red firearms jam only on a 1 on the Jam check.

factionRules.name: Partisan Support
factionRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any Round, choose one. Reinforcement: place a Red Guard with a Mosin-Nagant M1891 within 8 cm of any table edge and at least 20 cm from all enemies; it may activate this Round. Ambush: one enemy Soldier has 2 actions this Round.

rules.name: Steppe March
rules.text: Infantry ignore rough terrain on their first Move each activation.

rules.name: Forest Ambush
rules.text: After everyone else is deployed, place up to 3 of your Soldiers anywhere at least 20 cm from enemies.
